annotations.title: True cost of an employee (employer taxes and benefits)

description: True cost of an employee (employer taxes and benefits) — Fully loaded annual cost of a US employee from salary= (or hourly= + hours= per week): employer Social Security 6.2% to the SSA wage base (2024-2027, year=), Medicare 1.45%, FUTA 0.6% on $7,000 (futa_credit_reduction= for credit-reduction states), SUTA (state_rate= %, state_wage_base=), workers_comp= (rate per $100 payroll), health= (employer monthly premium), retirement_match= (% of salary), benefits=/equipment= (annual), bonus=. Returns tax breakdown, total and monthly cost, loaded multiplier, overhead %, cost per paid hour and per productive hour (pto_days=, holidays=). Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_employee_cost
